'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 671
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>Belladonna, my dear. If only I had gloves, then I could hold you at last.
|notes = Speak to the [[Tool Leprechaun]] near [[Draynor Manor]]'s grounds.
|map = {{Map|3088,3357|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Draynor Manor Teleport]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]] and run north.
*[[Skull sceptre (i)]] teleport and run south.
*[[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] and run north-west.
